title: Habiro cohomology foundations, Part II
summary: Use independently constructed refined trace filtrations as inputs to algebraic Habiro cohomology. This sequel proves the spherical-lift criterion after perfection, compares canonical and framed trace filtrations on their full common domain, and exports cyclotomic and Taylor maps from the genuine-fixed-point realization of number-field Habiro rings. All coefficient, prismatic and trace foundations are imported from their existing owners.
readme: HabiroCohomologyFoundations supplies derived q-de Rham complexes, coherent chosen pairs, Habiro descent and the trace-free canonical constructions. RefinedTraceMethods supplies the spherical-lift and E₁-resolution comparisons, the genuine cyclonic reconstruction and the comparison with independently defined prismatic Nygaard. HT.1 composes these interfaces and proves the relative perfected-lift application. HT.2 identifies the canonical framed output and transports the arithmetic specialization maps. Read research/blueprint/readmes/HabiroCohomologyFoundationsPartII.md for hypotheses, API and worked Checks. The dependency order is Part I → RefinedTraceMethods → Part II; the exact relocation manifest is in the design handoff.

stages.title: Trace pairs and perfected spherical lifts
stages.description: For a perfectly covered Λ-base with full spherical (tC_p) data, quasi-lci R with bounded p-power torsion, compatible per-prime E₂ or coherent E₁-resolution lifts, and the separate 2-adic E₁ addendum, form H(R,F_tr) by the existing chosen-pair descent. Preserve all four pair axioms, the completed shifted even TC⁻ comparison, q-Witt associated gradeds and only the supplied E_(n−1) multiplicativity. For a p-torsion-free, p-quasi-lci R over a p-completely perfectly covered δ-base with relatively semiperfect R/p, prove that an E₁ spherical lift of (R⊗_A A_∞)^∧_p makes the existing naive filtration a q-deformation. Retain the E₁ ku-lift counterexample and the independent prismatic/trace construction boundary as imported targets.

stages.title: Canonical and arithmetic trace exports
stages.description: For framed smooth S over a spherical cyclotomic perfectly covered Λ-base satisfying KU 6.7/6.10 and with all primes ≤the number of framing coordinates invertible, compare the completed trace filtration with the canonical coordinate filtration h^max(i−j,0)Ω^j[[h]], and pull back the particular equivalence to qdR and Habiro descent. For every number field F and positive Δ divisible by 6 and disc(F), transport the existing Habiro cyclotomic reductions and Frobenius-twisted Taylor maps through RT’s ring equivalence with π₀ of the divisibility limit of residual-circle homotopy fixed points of genuine C_m-fixed THH over periodic KU. Retain the operation order, degree-zero scope and stronger inversion hypotheses.
